device.list.doc: Every paired device, phones and browsers included, with its link.

device.rename.doc: Renames a device; a computer keeps its old tree name as an alias (§9.1).

device.revoke.doc: Revokes a device: its links are cut at once and a guided rotation of synced keys starts (§8.1).

device.pair.begin.doc: Shows a pairing code and QR for a device to join, without an account (§8.1).

device.pair.join.doc: Joins another device's pairing by its code or QR payload; both then show the same four words.

device.pair.confirm.doc: Confirms the four words; adding a device is a sealed card unless made in the user's own terminal.

account.status.doc: The waifucave account this computer is signed in with, if any (§8.1).

account.signIn.doc: Starts a sign-in; the client opens the URL. Signing in is enough to add a device (§8.1).

account.signOut.doc: Signs this computer out of the account.

main.get.doc: The main computer, the lease's holder and epoch, and the refresher.

main.set.doc: Chooses the main computer; a new cloud computer becomes main only after the user confirms (§6.4).

main.handOver.doc: Releases the lease now so another computer takes the bots (Hand over and quit, a laptop's sleep; §3.1, §6.4).

clock.status.doc: This device's shared-clock offset and accuracy (§6.4).

link.list.doc: This computer's links and their paths.

device.answerKey.set.doc: Registers this desktop's app-held answer key, proved by the app's own signature.

peer.hello.doc: Opens a link's session: links negotiate a protocol version and support one release back (§14.2 item 22).

peer.call.doc: Runs a method on this computer for a caller on another one: a message to a bot that thinks here, a card's answer.

link.session.deliver.doc: A bot's, an agent's or a routine's message, or an agent's final report, to a session that runs on this computer, from the computer that sent it.

peer.session.send.doc: A user's message from another device, for a bot that thinks here (§6.4). The receiver verifies the sending device's signature over the session, message id, message hash and send time; without a good one the turn it starts isn't the user's (review N3).

sync.heads.doc: The last entry of each stream this computer holds.

sync.pull.doc: Entries of a stream after a seq.

sync.push.doc: Appends entries; a stale base is refused, as the inherited phone sync refuses one (`ipc/sync.ts`). An entry that grants something (`PEER_STREAM_GRANTS`) waits for this computer's own card or a bound signed answer (review N7).

device_changed.doc: A device was added or changed, or came online or went offline.

device_removed.doc: A device was revoked or removed.

lease_changed.doc: The main computer, the lease's holder, its epoch or the refresher changed.

link_changed.doc: A link came up, went down or changed path.

account_changed.doc: The account was signed in or out.
